item.title: Ravens Waive G Ben Cleveland
item.description: The Baltimore Ravens officially waived veteran G Ben Cleveland on Thursday. Cleveland was suspended three games for violating the NFL’s substance abuse policy back in December. This stemmed from a DUI arrest this past February. Three games is the league’s baseline suspension for drinking and driving.
